verdict.rationale: Cognee documents dataset-scoped permissions for multiple users sharing one instance. That is related access control, but the evidence never shows issuing API keys or tokens, scoped or otherwise, for an agent. Treating an agent as a permissioned user would be a workaround, not a credential-issuance capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
